verdict.rationale: Honeycomb documents threshold-based Triggers and SLO burn alerts, with routing of notifications to Slack, PagerDuty, Microsoft Teams, or custom webhooks whose payloads can be templated. Alerting and routing are covered, but the evidence never mentions notification grouping or silencing/muting, and does not explicitly confirm triggers on every signal type. Missing for 10: notification grouping/deduplication, silencing/muting of alerts, explicit evidence that triggers work on all signal types (traces, logs, metrics), independent or hands-on corroboration.
